title: The Abyss Singing in Frequencies That Have No Bottom

features.name: frequency well
features.desc-on-touch: A spiral descending into sound itself. The frequencies go deeper than the ocean, lower than pressure, into a range where vibration becomes the only shape things have. You listen and realize the abyss is humming in a voice that has never stopped.

features.name: sonar recording
features.desc-on-touch: A device still receiving, never finished receiving. It plays back depths that have no bottom, calls that echo from the place where life remembers how to dream.

features.name: pressure membrane
features.desc-on-touch: The boundary where sound becomes weight. It trembles with transmission from below. You cannot see through it, but you feel the rhythm of something that lives in the dark and sings at frequencies you can only sense as cold.

inscription: the ocean sings to itself, and the archive listens in the dark

file.name: Hadal_Zone_Frequencies_Unfiltered.mp3
file.note: Recordings from depths where water pressure becomes the dominant sensory mode. Something down there is still learning to make sound.
